game_title: Frequency Bazaar – Supply Cache Camp Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Frost Peaks – Supply Cache Camp, a high supply cache: the summit pilot must handle ice hawks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Frequency Bazaar: Count how often each item appears using a dictionary.
theme: Frost Peaks – Supply Cache Camp: a high supply cache
core_gameplay_loop: In Supply Cache Camp, repeat each round: Count how often each item appears using a dictionary. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the summit pilot ahead. Then check the tally value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the summit beacon by solving code steps involving tally that move the summit pilot forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.15).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the summit beacon first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 8 (extended tier): Frequency Bazaar
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Frequency Bazaar' (Week 8 slot 9), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Supply Cache Camp'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
